enriched_activities.desc: Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn to back. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body and shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Get dressed. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen and turn on light. Open refrigerator, take out milk and butter, and close refrigerator. Open cabinet and take out bread. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Fill kettle with water and place on base. Press kettle switch. Take out mug and coffee. Scoop coffee into mug. Pour hot water into mug. Stir coffee. Take toast out of toaster and spread butter. Eat breakfast and drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing lunch and work bag, tidying up kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator and take out lunch container and fruit. Place in bag. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet and take out snacks. Place in bag. Zip bag. Wipe kitchen counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist: assessing and treating patients, running rehabilitation exercises
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Pick up clipboard. Review patient chart. Ask patient to sit. Ask patient to lift arm. Palpate shoulder. Ask patient to resist. Take notes. Instruct patient to perform exercise. Demonstrate exercise. Observe patient. Correct patient's posture. Walk to next patient. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital and eating packed lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to break room. Open locker. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch container. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Close container. Put back in bag. Walk to locker. Put bag in locker. Close locker. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist: continuing patient sessions, writing treatment notes and handover documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Review patient notes. Assess patient. Instruct patient exercise. Demonstrate exercise. Observe patient. Correct posture. Take notes. Walk to desk. Open computer. Type treatment notes. Save notes. Print handover documentation. Walk to colleague. Hand over documentation. Discuss patient. Walk to next patient.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator and take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil and meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher, cleaning up after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape plates into trash. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe counters. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting on a load of laundry in the washing machine and tidying the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Gather dirty clothes. Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Add detergent. Close door. Select cycle. Press start. Wipe sink. Wipe mirror. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and catching up on messages on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Put phone down. Watch TV. Pick up phone again. Check social media. Put phone down. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap and light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Set alarm on phone. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
